parameters.query:
INSERT INTO n8n_chat_histories (session_id, message)
SELECT $1, $2::jsonb
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM n8n_chat_histories
  WHERE session_id = $1 AND message->>'type' = 'system'
)
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Insert system FORM (idempotent)1
nodes.notes: Idempotente: solo inserta si no existe ya un system para este session_id. WHERE NOT EXISTS cubre re-envíos del cron.
